p3.original: The Great Recession ended in June 2009 after 18 months, according to the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER). The NBER examines a variety of measures of economic activity to gauge the economy's overall health. These measures include real income, wholesale and retail sales, employment, and industrial production. In the years since the official end of this historic economic downturn, it has become clear that the Great Recession was two-pronged, hitting the U.S. economy with the collapse of the housing market and the failure of the financial system's credit institutions, further contaminating global economies. While the stock market rapidly lost trillions of dollars of value, consumer spending dried up, and companies began cutting jobs, economic policymakers were struggling with how to best combat and prevent a national, and even global economic collapse. In the end, policymakers used a number of controversial monetary and fiscal policies to support the housing market and domestic industries as well as to stabilize the financial sector. Some of these initiatives included:
p3.zh: 根据国家经济研究局(NBER)的统计,大衰退在18个月后于2009年6月结束.国家经济活动评估局审查各种经济活动措施,以衡量经济的总体健康状况。 这些措施包括实际收入、批发和零售、就业和工业生产。 在这场历史经济衰退正式结束的几年里,很明显大衰退是双管齐下的,随着住房市场的崩溃和金融体系信贷机构的失败,美国经济受到打击,进一步污染了全球经济.股市迅速损失价值数万亿美元,消费者支出枯竭,公司开始削减就业,与此同时,经济决策者却在努力设法最佳地打击和防止国家乃至全球经济崩溃。最终,决策者利用一些有争议的货币和财政政策支持住房市场和国内产业,并稳定金融部门。其中一些举措包括:

p4.original: Federal Reserve Bank purchase of both traditional and nontraditional assets off banks' balance sheets. By doing this, the Fed injected money into the banking system and increased the amounts of funds available to lend to the business sector and consumers. This also dropped short-term interest rates to as low as zero percent, which had the effect of devaluing U.S. dollars in the global market and boosting exports.
p4.zh: 联邦储备银行从银行资产负债表中购买传统资产和非传统资产。 通过这样做,美联储向银行系统注入资金,并增加了可用于向商业部门和消费者贷款的资金数额。 这还使短期利率降至零,从而降低了美元在全球市场上的价值,促进了出口。

p5.original: The Congress and the President also passed several pieces of legislation that would stabilize the financial market. The Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP), passed in late 2008, allowed the government to inject cash into troubled banks and other financial institutions and help support General Motors and Chrysler as they faced bankruptcy and threatened job losses throughout their supply chain. The American Recovery and Reinvestment Act in early 2009 provided tax rebates to low- and middle-income households to encourage consumer spending.
p5.zh: 国会和总统还通过了数项立法,稳定金融市场。2008年末通过的麻烦资产救济方案(TARP)使政府能够向麻烦的银行和其他金融机构注入现金,并帮助支持通用汽车公司和克莱斯勒公司,因为他们在整个供应链中面临破产和失业威胁。2009年初的《美国复苏和再投资法》规定,对中低收入家庭给予税收减免,以鼓励消费者支出。

p6.original: Four years after the end of the Great Recession, the economy had yet to return to its pre-recession levels of productivity and growth. Annual productivity increased only 1.9% between 2009 and 2012 compared to its 2.7% annual growth rate between 2000 and 2007, unemployment remained above the natural rate, and real GDP continued to lag behind potential growth. The actions the government took to stabilize the economy were under scrutiny and debate about their effectiveness continues. In this chapter, we will discuss the neoclassical perspective on economics and compare it to the Keynesian perspective, using both the Great Recession and the more recent pandemic-induced recession as examples.
p6.zh: 大衰退结束四年后,经济尚未恢复到衰退前的生产力水平和增长水平.2009至2012年,年生产率仅增长1.9%,而2000至2007年的年增长率为2.7%,失业率仍然高于自然增长率,实际国内生产总值继续落后于潜在增长。 政府为稳定经济而采取的行动正在受到审查,对其有效性的辩论仍在继续。 在本章中,我们将讨论经济学的新古典主义观点,并将它与凯恩斯主义观点进行比较,同时以大衰退和最近流行引起的衰退为例。

p12.original: In Chicago, Illinois, the highest recorded temperature was 105° in July 1995, while the lowest recorded temperature was 27° below zero in January 1958. Understanding why these extreme weather patterns occurred would be interesting. However, if you wanted to understand the typical weather pattern in Chicago, instead of focusing on one-time extremes, you would need to look at the entire pattern of data over time.
p12.zh: 在伊利诺伊州芝加哥,1995年7月的最高记录气温为105°,而1958年1月的最低记录气温低于零下27°.了解这些极端天气模式的发生原因将很有趣。 然而,如果你想要了解芝加哥典型的天气模式, 而不是专注于一次性的极端, 你将需要研究整个数据模式 随着时间的推移。

p13.original: A similar lesson applies to the study of macroeconomics. It is interesting to study extreme situations, like the 1930s Great Depression, the 2008–2009 Great Recession, or the pandemic-induced recession of 2020. If you want to understand the whole picture, however, you need to look at the long term. Consider the unemployment rate. The unemployment rate has fluctuated from as low as 3.5% in 1969 to as high as 9.7% in 1982 and 8.1% in 2020. Even as the U.S. unemployment rate rose during recessions and declined during expansions, it kept returning to the general neighborhood of 5.0%. When the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office carried out its long-range economic forecasts in 2010, it assumed that from 2015 to 2020, after the recession has passed, the unemployment rate would be 5.0%. In February 2020, before the COVID-19 pandemic, the unemployment rate reached a historic low of 3.5% and is back to below 5% as of early 2022. From a long-run perspective, the economy seems to keep adjusting back to this rate of unemployment.
p13.zh: 类似的教训也适用于宏观经济学的研究.研究极端情况,如20世纪30年代的大萧条、2008-2009年的大衰退或2020年大流行引发的衰退,是很有趣的。 但是,如果你想了解整个情况,你需要看长远。考虑一下失业率。失业率从1969年的3.5%低到1982年的9.7%和2020年的8.1%。即使在经济衰退期间美国失业率上升,扩张期间失业率下降,美国仍然继续回到5.0%的一般街区.2010年无党派国会预算办公室进行远程经济预测时,假设2015年至2020年,经济衰退过后,失业率将达到5.0%.2020年2月,COVID-19大流行前,失业率达到历史最低点3.5%,到2022年初又回到5%以下. 从长远的角度来看,经济似乎不断适应这种失业率。

p14.original: As the name “neoclassical” implies, this perspective of how the macroeconomy works is a “new” view of the “old” classical model of the economy. The classical view, the predominant economic philosophy until the Great Depression, was that short-term fluctuations in economic activity would rather quickly, with flexible prices, adjust back to full employment. This view of the economy implied a vertical aggregate supply curve at full employment GDP, and prescribed a “hands off” policy approach. For example, if the economy were to slip into recession (a leftward shift of the aggregate demand curve), it would temporarily exhibit a surplus of goods. Falling prices would eliminate this surplus, and the economy would return to full employment level of GDP. No active fiscal or monetary policy was needed. In fact, the classical view was that expansionary fiscal or monetary policy would only cause inflation, rather than increase GDP. The deep and lasting impact of the Great Depression changed this thinking and Keynesian economics, which prescribed active fiscal policy to alleviate weak aggregate demand, became the more mainstream perspective.
p14.zh: 正如“新古典主义”这一名称所暗示的,宏观经济如何运作的这种观点是对“旧”古典经济模式的“新”观点。古典主义观点是大萧条之前的主要经济哲学,认为经济活动的短期波动会随着价格的灵活而迅速调整,以恢复充分就业。 这种对经济的看法意味着在充分就业的国内生产总值中纵向的总供应曲线,并规定一种“放任”政策办法。 例如,如果经济陷入衰退(总需求曲线的左倾转变),将暂时出现商品盈余。物价下跌将消除这种盈余,经济将恢复到国内生产总值的充分就业水平。不需要积极的财政或货币政策。 事实上,古典观点认为扩张性的财政或货币政策只会造成通货膨胀,而不是增加GDP. 大萧条的深刻而持久的影响改变了这种思想,凯恩斯主义经济学为缓解疲软的总需求规定了积极的财政政策,成为了更主流的视角.

p15.original: The Building Blocks of Neoclassical Analysis
p15.zh: 新古典主义分析的建筑区块

p16.original: The neoclassical perspective on macroeconomics holds that, in the long run, the economy will fluctuate around its potential GDP and its natural rate of unemployment. This chapter begins with two building blocks of neoclassical economics: (1) potential GDP determines the economy's size and (2) wages and prices will adjust in a flexible manner so that the economy will adjust back to its potential GDP level of output. The key policy implication is this: The government should focus more on long-term growth and on controlling inflation than on worrying about recession or cyclical unemployment. This focus on long-run growth rather than the short-run fluctuations in the business cycle means that neoclassical economics is more useful for long-run macroeconomic analysis and Keynesian economics is more useful for analyzing the macroeconomic short run. Let's consider the two neoclassical building blocks in turn, and how we can embody them in the aggregate demand/aggregate supply model.
p16.zh: 宏观经济的新古典主义观点认为,从长远来看,经济将围绕其潜在的国内生产总值和自然失业率而波动。本章以新古典主义经济学的两个构件为开端:(1)潜在的GDP决定经济规模,(2)工资和价格将灵活调整,使经济重新适应其潜在的GDP产出水平.关键的政策含义是:政府应该更多地关注长期增长和控制通货膨胀,而不是担心衰退或周期性失业。 这种注重长期增长而不是商业周期的短期波动,意味着新古典主义经济学更有利于长期宏观经济分析,凯恩斯主义经济学更有利于宏观经济短期分析. 让我们来依次考虑两个新古典主义的构件, 以及如何把它们体现于总需求/总供给模型中.

p17.original: The Importance of Potential GDP in the Long Run
p17.zh: 潜在国内生产总值在长跑中的重要性

p18.original: Over the long run, the level of potential GDP determines the size of real GDP. When economists refer to “potential GDP” they are referring to that level of output that an economy can achieve when all resources (land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurial ability) are fully employed. While the unemployment rate in labor markets will never be zero, full employment in the labor market refers to zero cyclical unemployment. There will still be some level of unemployment due to frictional or structural unemployment, but when the economy is operating with zero cyclical unemployment, economists say that the economy is at the natural rate of unemployment or at full employment.
p18.zh: 从长远来看,潜在的国内生产总值水平决定了实际国内生产总值的规模。 当经济学家提到“潜在的国内生产总值”时,他们指的是当所有资源(土地、劳动力、资本和创业能力)都得到充分利用时,一个经济体能够达到的这一产出水平。 虽然劳动力市场的失业率永远不会是零,但劳动力市场的充分就业是指零周期性失业。 由于摩擦性或结构性失业,仍然会有一定程度的失业,但当经济运行时周期性零失业时,经济学家说,经济处于自然失业率或充分就业水平.

p19.original: Economists benchmark actual or real GDP against the potential GDP to determine how well the economy is performing. As explained in Economic Growth, we can explain GDP growth by increases in investment in physical capital and human capital per person as well as advances in technology. Physical capital per person refers to the amount and kind of machinery and equipment available to help people get work done. Compare, for example, your productivity in typing a term paper on a typewriter to working on your laptop with word processing software. Clearly, you will be able to be more productive using word processing software. The technology and level of capital of your laptop and software has increased your productivity. More broadly, the development of GPS technology and Universal Product Codes (those barcodes on every product we buy) has made it much easier for firms to track shipments, tabulate inventories, and sell and distribute products. These two technological innovations, and many others, have increased a nation's ability to produce goods and services for a given population. Likewise, increasing human capital involves increasing levels of knowledge, education, and skill sets per person through vocational or higher education. Physical and human capital improvements with technological advances will increase overall productivity and, thus, GDP.
p19.zh: 经济学家将实际或实际国内总产值与潜在国内总产值相比较,以确定经济表现如何。 正如《经济增长》所解释的那样,我们可以通过人均有形资本和人力资本投资的增加以及技术进步来解释国内生产总值的增长。人均实物资本是指可用于帮助人们完成工作的机器和设备的数量和种类。 例如,比较一下,你在打字机上打字的术语纸的生产率,就可以用文字处理软件在笔记本电脑上工作.很明显,你能够使用文字处理软件来提高生产率。 你的笔记本电脑和软件的技术和资本水平提高了你的生产力。更广泛地说,GPS技术和通用产品代码(我们购买的每一种产品上的条码)的发展,使公司更方便地追踪货运、编目库存以及销售和分销产品。这两项技术革新以及许多其他革新,提高了一个国家为特定人口生产货物和服务的能力。 同样,人力资本的增加涉及通过职业教育或高等教育提高每个人的知识、教育和技能。 随着技术进步,物质和人力资本的改善将提高总体生产力,从而增加国内生产总值。

p20.original: To see how these improvements have increased productivity and output at the national level, we should examine evidence from the United States. The United States experienced significant growth in the twentieth century due to phenomenal changes in infrastructure, equipment, and technological improvements in physical capital and human capital. The population more than tripled in the twentieth century, from 76 million in 1900 to over 300 million in 2016. The human capital of modern workers is far higher today because the education and skills of workers have risen dramatically. In 1900, only about one-eighth of the U.S. population had completed high school and just one person in 40 had completed a four-year college degree. By 2010, about 8.5% of Americans age 25 or older had a high school degree and about 28% had a four-year college degree as well. In 2019, 33% of Americans age 25 or older had a four-year college degree. The average amount of physical capital per worker has grown dramatically. The technology available to modern workers is extraordinarily better than a century ago: cars, airplanes, electrical machinery, smartphones, computers, chemical and biological advances, materials science, health care—the list of technological advances could run on and on. More workers, higher skill levels, larger amounts of physical capital per worker, and amazingly better technology, and potential GDP for the U.S. economy has clearly increased a great deal since 1900.
p20.zh: 为了了解这些改进如何提高了国家一级的生产力和产出,我们应当审查美国提供的证据。 由于基础设施、设备以及有形资本和人力资本的技术改进的显著变化,美国在20世纪经历了显著增长。人口在20世纪增加了两倍多,从1900年的7600万增加到2016年的3亿多.现代工人的人力资本今天要高得多,因为工人的教育和技能已经急剧上升。1900年,只有约八分之一的美国人口完成了高中学业,40人中只有一人完成了四年制大学学位. 到2010年,约8.5%的25岁或25岁以上的美国人拥有高中学位,约28%的美国人也拥有四年制大学学位.2019年,有33%的25岁或以上的美国人拥有四年制大学学位. 每个工人的平均实物资本数额急剧增长。现代工人可以利用的技术比一个世纪前特别好:汽车、飞机、电力机械、智能手机、计算机、化学和生物进步、材料科学、保健——技术进步清单可以不断更新。更多的工人,更高的技能水平,每个工人的实物资本量更大,技术也惊人的更好,以及美国经济的潜在GDP自1900年以来明显地增长了很多.

p21.original: This growth has fallen below its potential GDP and, at times, has exceeded its potential. For example from 2008 to 2009, the U.S. economy tumbled into recession and remained below its potential until 2018. After the pandemic-induced recession of March and April 2020, the economy again fell below potential GDP and remains there as of early 2022. At other times, like in the late 1990s or from 2018 to 2020, the economy ran at potential GDP—or even slightly ahead.  shows the actual data for the increase in real GDP since 1960. The slightly smoother line shows the potential GDP since 1960 as estimated by the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office. Most economic recessions and upswings are times when the economy is 1–3% below or above potential GDP in a given year. Clearly, short-run fluctuations around potential GDP do exist, but over the long run, the upward trend of potential GDP determines the size of the economy.
p21.zh: 这一增长已低于其潜在的国内生产总值,有时甚至超过了其潜力。 例如,从2008年到2009年,美国经济陷入衰退,直到2018年仍低于其潜力。 在2020年3月和4月大流行病引发的衰退之后,经济再次低于潜在的国内生产总值,截至2022年初,经济仍然处于这一水平。 在另一些情况下,如1990年代末或2018年至2020年,经济以潜在的国内生产总值运行,甚至略微领先。 显示了1960年以来实际国内生产总值增长的实际数据。稍稍平滑的一行显示自1960年以来,无党派国会预算办公室估计的潜在GDP.多数经济衰退和上升是某一年经济低于或高于潜在GDP的1-3 % 。 显然,围绕潜在国内生产总值的短期波动确实存在,但从长远来看,潜在国内生产总值的上升趋势决定了经济的规模。

p22.zh: 1958-2020年潜在和实际国内生产总值(单位:2012美元)

p23.original: In the aggregate demand/aggregate supply model, we show potential GDP as a vertical line. Neoclassical economists who focus on potential GDP as the primary determinant of real GDP argue that the long-run aggregate supply curve is located at potential GDP—that is, we draw the long-run aggregate supply curve as a vertical line at the level of potential GDP, as  shows. A vertical LRAS curve means that the level of aggregate supply (or potential GDP) will determine the economy's real GDP, regardless of the level of aggregate demand. Over time, increases in the quantity and quality of physical capital, increases in human capital, and technological advancements shift potential GDP and the vertical LRAS curve gradually to the right. Economists often describe this gradual increase in an economy's potential GDP as a nation's long-term economic growth.
p23.zh: 在总需求/总供应模式中,我们显示潜在的国内生产总值为垂直线。 新古典主义经济学家将潜在国内总产值作为实际国内总产值的主要决定因素,他们认为长期总供应曲线位于潜在国内总产值,即我们绘制长期总供应曲线,作为潜在国内总产值水平的垂直线,如所示。垂直的LISS曲线意味着总供给水平(或潜在GDP)将决定经济体的实际GDP,而无论总需求水平如何.随着时间的推移,有形资本的数量和质量增加,人力资本增加,技术进步使潜在的国内生产总值和纵向LISS曲线逐渐向右转移。经济学家经常将经济潜在GDP的这种逐渐增长描述为一个国家的长期经济增长.

p26.original: How does the macroeconomy adjust back to its level of potential GDP in the long run? What if aggregate demand increases or decreases? Economists base the neoclassical view of how the macroeconomy adjusts on the insight that even if wages and prices are “sticky”, or slow to change, in the short run, they are flexible over time. To understand this better, let's follow the connections from the short-run to the long-run macroeconomic equilibrium.
p26.zh: 从长远看,宏观经济如何调整到其潜在的GDP水平? 如果总需求增加或减少怎么办?经济学家们将新古典主义观点作为宏观经济如何调整的基础,认为即使工资和价格“僵硬”,或变化缓慢,在短期内,它们也是灵活的。 为了更好地理解这一点,让我们关注从短期到长期宏观经济平衡的联系。

p27.original: The aggregate demand and aggregate supply diagram in  shows two aggregate supply curves. We draw the original upward sloping aggregate supply curve (SRAS0) as a short-run or Keynesian AS curve. The vertical aggregate supply curve (LRASn) is the long-run or neoclassical AS curve, which is located at potential GDP. The original aggregate demand curve, labeled AD0, so that the original equilibrium occurs at point E0, at which point the economy is producing at its potential GDP.
p27.zh: 总体需求和总供应图显示了两个总体供应曲线。 我们绘制了原来的向上斜斜的总供给曲线(SRAS0),作为短程或凯恩斯AS曲线.垂直总供应曲线(LIRSn)是长期或新古典化AS曲线,位于潜在的GDP.原总需求曲线,标注为AD0,因此原平衡发生在E0点,此时经济正在生产其潜在的GDP.

p28.original: The Rebound to Potential GDP after AD Increases
p28.zh: AD 增加后重新与潜在国内生产总值挂钩

p29.original: Now, imagine that some economic event boosts aggregate demand: perhaps a surge of export sales or a rise in business confidence that leads to more investment, perhaps a policy decision like higher government spending, or perhaps a tax cut that leads to additional aggregate demand. The short-run Keynesian analysis is that the rise in aggregate demand will shift the aggregate demand curve out to the right, from AD0 to AD1, leading to a new equilibrium at point E1 with higher output, lower unemployment, and pressure for an inflationary rise in the price level.
p29.zh: 现在,想象一下一些经济事件会刺激总需求:也许出口销售量激增或商业信心提高,从而导致更多的投资,也许可以做出政府支出增加等政策决定,或者削减税收,从而导致增加总需求。短期凯恩斯主义分析认为,总需求的上升将使总需求曲线向右转移,从AD0转向AD1,导致E1点出现新的平衡,产出较高,失业率较低,价格水平出现通胀上涨的压力.

p30.original: In the long-run neoclassical analysis, however, the chain of economic events is just beginning. As economic output rises above potential GDP, the level of unemployment falls. The economy is now above full employment and there is a labor shortage. Eager employers are trying to bid workers away from other companies and to encourage their current workers to exert more effort and to work longer hours. This high demand for labor will drive up wages. Most employers review their workers salaries only once or twice a year, and so it will take time before the higher wages filter through the economy. As wages do rise, it will mean a leftward shift in the short-run Keynesian aggregate supply curve back to SRAS1, because the price of a major input to production has increased. The economy moves to a new equilibrium (E2). The new equilibrium has the same level of real GDP as did the original equilibrium (E0), but there has been an inflationary increase in the price level.
p30.zh: 然而,在长期的新古典主义分析中,经济事件的连锁关系刚刚开始. 随着经济产出超过潜在国内生产总值,失业率下降。经济现在已超过充分就业,而且劳动力短缺。雇主正在试图将工人从其他公司引走,并鼓励其目前的工人作出更大的努力,并延长工作时间。如此高的劳动力需求将推动工资增长。 大多数雇主每年只审查一次或两次工人的工资,因此,要花时间才能使较高的工资渗透到经济中。 随着工资的提高,这将意味着凯恩斯主义短期总供应曲线向左转回SRAS1,因为对生产的主要投入的价格已经上涨.经济走向新的平衡(E2)。新的平衡与原来的平衡(E0)具有相同的实际GDP水平,但价格水平出现了通货膨胀上升。

p31.original: This description of the short-run shift from E0 to E1 and the long-run shift from E1 to E2 is a step-by-step way of making a simple point: the economy cannot sustain production above its potential GDP in the long run. An economy may produce above its level of potential GDP in the short run, under pressure from a surge in aggregate demand. Over the long run, however, that surge in aggregate demand ends up as an increase in the price level, not as a rise in output.
p31.zh: 这种对E0到E1的短期转移和E1到E2的长期转移的描述,是一步步地提出简单点的方法:从长远来看,经济无法维持超过其潜在GDP的生产. 从短期来看,在总需求猛增的压力下,一个经济体的产量可能超过其潜在的国内总产值水平。 然而,从长远来看,总需求的激增最终是价格水平的提高,而不是产出的提高。

p32.original: The rebound of the economy back to potential GDP also works in response to a shift to the left in aggregate demand.  again starts with two aggregate supply curves, with SRAS0 showing the original upward sloping short-run Keynesian AS curve and LRASn showing the vertical long-run neoclassical aggregate supply curve. A decrease in aggregate demand—for example, because of a decline in consumer confidence that leads to less consumption and more saving—causes the original aggregate demand curve AD0 to shift back to AD1. The shift from the original equilibrium (E0) to the new equilibrium (E1) results in a decline in output. The economy is now below full employment and there is a surplus of labor. As output falls below potential GDP, unemployment rises. While a lower price level (i.e., deflation) is rare in the United States, it does happen occasionally during very weak periods of economic activity. For practical purposes, we might consider a lower price level in the AD–AS model as indicative of disinflation, which is a decline in the inflation rate. Thus, the long-run aggregate supply curve LRASn, which is vertical at the level of potential GDP, ultimately determines this economy's real GDP.
p32.zh: 经济回升到潜在的GDP也是为了应对总需求左倾的转变。 再一次从两个总供给曲线开始,SRAS0显示的是最初向上倾斜的凯恩斯AS短线曲线,而LISSn显示的是垂直的长线新古典主义总供给曲线。总体需求减少——例如,由于消费者信心下降,导致消费减少和储蓄增加——导致原先的总需求曲线AD0转向AD1。 从原来的平衡(E0)向新的平衡(E1)的转变导致产出下降.经济现在低于充分就业,劳动力过剩。 随着产出低于潜在国内生产总值,失业率上升。 虽然低价水平(即通货紧缩)在美国是罕见的,但在经济活动非常薄弱的时期偶尔会发生. 为了实际目的,我们可以认为AD-AS模式中较低的价格水平表明通货膨胀下降,即通货膨胀率下降。 因此,长期总供给曲线LISSn在潜在GDP水平上是垂直的,最终决定了本经济体的实际GDP.

p33.original: A Rebound Back to Potential GDP from a Shift to the Left in Aggregate Demand
p33.zh: 从需求总量中向左转移返回潜在GDP

p34.original: Again, from the neoclassical perspective, this short-run scenario is only the beginning of the chain of events. The higher level of unemployment means more workers looking for jobs. As a result, employers can hold down on pay increases—or perhaps even replace some of their higher-paid workers with unemployed people willing to accept a lower wage. As wages stagnate or fall, this decline in the price of a key input means that the short-run Keynesian aggregate supply curve shifts to the right from its original (SRAS0 to SRAS1). The overall impact in the long run, as the macroeconomic equilibrium shifts from E0 to E1 to E2, is that the level of output returns to potential GDP, where it started. There is, however, downward pressure on the price level. Thus, in the neoclassical view, changes in aggregate demand can have a short-run impact on output and on unemployment—but only a short-run impact. In the long run, when wages and prices are flexible, potential GDP and aggregate supply determine real GDP's size.
p34.zh: 同样,从新古典主义的角度来看,这种短时间的情景只是一系列事件的开始.较高的失业率意味着更多的工人寻找工作。 因此,雇主可以坚持提高工资,甚至用愿意接受较低工资的失业人员来取代一些高工资工人。 随着工资停滞或下降,关键投入价格的这一下降意味着凯恩斯式的短期总供应曲线从原来的(SRAS0)转向右侧. 从长远来看,随着宏观经济平衡从E0向E1向E2转变,总的影响是产出水平恢复到其开始的潜在国内生产总值。 然而,价格水平面临下行压力。 因此,在新古典主义观点中,总需求的变化可能对产出和失业产生短期影响,但只是短期影响。 从长远来看,当工资和价格灵活时,潜在的国内生产总值和总供应决定着实际国内生产总值的规模。

p35.original: How Fast Is the Speed of Macroeconomic Adjustment?
p35.zh: 宏观经济调整速度有多快?.

p36.original: How long does it take for wages and prices to adjust, and for the economy to rebound to its potential GDP? This subject is highly contentious. Keynesian economists argue that if the adjustment from recession to potential GDP takes a very long time, then neoclassical theory may be more hypothetical than practical. In response to John Maynard Keynes' immortal words, “In the long run we are all dead,” neoclassical economists respond that even if the adjustment takes as long as, say, ten years the neoclassical perspective remains of central importance in understanding the economy.
p36.zh: 工资和价格需要多长时间才能调整,经济需要多长时间才能恢复到其潜在的国内生产总值?这个问题极具争议。 凯恩斯主义经济学家认为,如果从衰退到潜在GDP的调整需要很长的时间,那么新古典主义理论可能比实际的更是假设性的. 针对约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯的不朽之词,“从长远来看,我们都死了”,新古典主义经济学家回答说,即使调整需要十年时间,但新古典主义观点在理解经济方面仍然至关重要。

p37.original: One subset of neoclassical economists holds that wage and price adjustment in the macroeconomy might be quite rapid. The theory of rational expectations holds that people form the most accurate possible expectations about the future that they can, using all information available to them. In an economy where most people have rational expectations, economic adjustments may happen very quickly.
p37.zh: 新古典主义经济学家的一个子集认为,宏观经济中的工资和价格调整可能相当迅速。理性期望的理论认为,人们利用他们可以得到的所有信息,对自己能够实现的未来形成最准确的预期. 在大多数人有合理预期的经济体中,经济调整可能很快发生.

p38.original: To understand how rational expectations may affect the speed of price adjustments, think about a situation in the real estate market. Imagine that several events seem likely to push up home values in the neighborhood. Perhaps a local employer announces that it plans to hire many more people or the city announces that it will build a local park or a library in that neighborhood. The theory of rational expectations points out that even though none of the changes will happen immediately, home prices in the neighborhood will rise immediately, because the expectation that homes will be worth more in the future will lead buyers to be willing to pay more in the present. The amount of the immediate increase in home prices will depend on how likely it seems that the announcements about the future will actually happen and on how distant the local jobs and neighborhood improvements are in the future. The key point is that, because of rational expectations, prices do not wait on events, but adjust immediately.
p38.zh: 要了解合理预期会如何影响价格调整的速度,考虑一下房地产市场的情况.想象一下,一些事件似乎有可能在附近推高家庭价值观。当地雇主可能宣布计划再雇用更多人, 或市政府宣布将在附近建造当地公园或图书馆。理性期望的理论指出,尽管不会立即发生任何变化,但街区的房价会立即上涨,因为预期将来房屋会更值钱,这将导致买家愿意在目前支付更多.房屋价格的立即上涨幅度将取决于关于未来的公告似乎会在多大程度上实际发生,以及当地工作和邻里改善在未来有多远。关键是,由于合理的期望,价格不会在事件上等待,而是立即调整.

p39.original: At a macroeconomic level, the theory of rational expectations points out that if the aggregate supply curve is vertical over time, then people should rationally expect this pattern. When a shift in aggregate demand occurs, people and businesses with rational expectations will know that its impact on output and employment will be temporary, while its impact on the price level will be permanent. If firms and workers perceive the outcome of the process in advance, and if all firms and workers know that everyone else is perceiving the process in the same way, then they have no incentive to go through an extended series of short-run scenarios, like a firm first hiring more people when aggregate demand shifts out and then firing those same people when aggregate supply shifts back. Instead, everyone will recognize where this process is heading—toward a change in the price level—and then will act on that expectation. In this scenario, the expected long-run change in the price level may happen very quickly, without a drawn-out zigzag of output and employment first moving one way and then the other.
p39.zh: 在宏观经济层面上,理性预期的理论指出,如果总供给曲线随时间推移而垂直,那么人们应该合理预期这种模式. 当总需求发生转变时,有合理预期的人和企业会知道其对产出和就业的影响将是暂时的,而其对价格水平的影响将是永久的. 如果公司和工人事先意识到这一过程的结果,如果所有公司和工人都知道其他人都以同样的方式看待这一过程,那么他们就没有动力经历一系列延长的短期情况,比如公司在总需求转移时首先雇用更多的人,然后在总供应回流时解雇同样的人。 相反,每个人都会认识到这一进程的方向——价格水平将发生变化——然后将按这一期望采取行动。 在这种情况下,预期价格水平的长期变化可能很快发生,没有产出和就业的耗尽的Zigzag先行一步,再行一步。

p40.original: The theory that people and firms have rational expectations can be a useful simplification, but as a statement about how people and businesses actually behave, the assumption seems too strong. After all, many people and firms are not especially well informed, either about what is happening in the economy or about how the economy works. An alternate assumption is that people and firms act with adaptive expectations: they look at past experience and gradually adapt their beliefs and behavior as circumstances change, but are not perfect synthesizers of information and accurate predictors of the future in the sense of rational expectations theory. If most people and businesses have some form of adaptive expectations, then the adjustment from the short run and long run will be traced out in incremental steps that occur over time.
p40.zh: 人和公司有合理期望的理论可以是一种有用的简化,但作为说明人和企业实际行为的方式,这种假设似乎太强.毕竟,许多人和公司对经济正在发生的情况或经济的运作情况了解不够。另一种假设是,人和公司的行为符合适应性预期:他们审视过去的经验,随着环境的变化逐步调整他们的信仰和行为,但并不是在理性预期理论意义上的完美的信息合成者和准确的未来预测者. 如果大多数人和企业有某种形式的适应性预期,那么,从短期和长期来看的调整将随着时间推移逐步进行。

p41.original: The empirical evidence on the speed of macroeconomic adjustment of prices and wages is not clear-cut. The speed of macroeconomic adjustment probably varies among different countries and time periods. A reasonable guess is that the initial short-run effect of a shift in aggregate demand might last two to five years, before the adjustments in wages and prices cause the economy to adjust back to potential GDP. Thus, one might think of the short run for applying Keynesian analysis as time periods less than two to five years, and the long run for applying neoclassical analysis as longer than five years. For practical purposes, this guideline is frustratingly imprecise, but when analyzing a complex social mechanism like an economy as it evolves over time, some imprecision seems unavoidable.
p41.zh: 关于价格和工资宏观经济调整速度的经验证据并不明确。不同国家和不同时期的宏观经济调整速度可能各不相同。 一个合理的猜测是,总需求转变的最初短期影响可能持续两至五年,而工资和价格的调整导致经济重新适应潜在的国内生产总值。 因此,人们可能会认为,应用凯恩斯主义分析的时间短于两年至五年,应用新古典主义分析的时间长于五年。在实践中,这一准则令人沮丧地是不准确的,但当分析一个复杂的社会机制,如经济随着时间演变而演变时,某些不精确似乎不可避免。

p43.original: The neoclassical perspective argues that, in the long run, the economy will adjust back to its potential GDP level of output through flexible price levels. Thus, the neoclassical perspective views the long-run AS curve as vertical. A rational expectations perspective argues that people have excellent information about economic events and how the economy works and that, as a result, price and other economic adjustments will happen very quickly. In adaptive expectations theory, people have limited information about economic information and how the economy works, and so price and other economic adjustments can be slow.
p43.zh: 新古典主义观点认为,从长远来看,经济将通过灵活的价格水平,重新调整到其潜在的GDP产出水平. 因此,新古典主义视角将长期AS曲线视为垂直.理性的预期观点认为,人们对经济事件和经济运行方式有极佳的信息,因此,价格和其他经济调整会很快发生. 在适应性预期理论中,人们对于经济信息以及经济如何运作的信息有限,因此价格和其他经济调整可能缓慢.

p45.original: Do rational expectations tend to look back at past experience while adaptive expectations look ahead to the future? Explain your answer.
p45.zh: 理性的期望是否倾向于回顾过去的经验,而适应性的期望则展望未来?解释你的答案。

p46.original: No, this statement is false. It would be more accurate to say that rational expectations seek to predict the future as accurately as possible, using all of past experience as a guide. Adaptive expectations are largely backward looking; that is, they adapt as experience accumulates, but without attempting to look forward.
p46.zh: 不,这个陈述是假的。更准确的说法是,理智的期望力求尽可能准确地预测未来,把过去的所有经验作为指南。适应性预期主要是向后看,即随着经验的积累而适应,但并不试图向前看。

p48.original: Does neoclassical economics focus on the long term or the short term? Explain your answer.
p48.zh: 新古典主义经济学是注重长期还是短期?.解释你的答案。

p49.zh: 新古典主义经济学认为物价和工资是粘滞的还是灵活的? 为什么?

p87.original: The Policy Implications of the Neoclassical Perspective
p87.zh: 新古典主义观点的政策影响

p88.original: To understand the policy recommendations of the neoclassical economists, it helps to start with the Keynesian perspective. Suppose a decrease in aggregate demand causes the economy to go into recession with high unemployment. The Keynesian response would be to use government policy to stimulate aggregate demand and eliminate the recessionary gap. The neoclassical economists believe that the Keynesian response, while perhaps well intentioned, will not have a good outcome for reasons we will discuss shortly. Since the neoclassical economists believe that the economy will correct itself over time, the only advantage of a Keynesian stabilization policy would be to accelerate the process and minimize the time that the unemployed are out of work. Is that the likely outcome?
p88.zh: 为了理解新古典主义经济学家的政策建议,它有助于从凯恩斯主义的观点开始.假设总需求下降导致经济陷入高失业率的衰退。 凯恩斯主义的反应是利用政府政策刺激总需求并消除衰退差距。 新古典主义经济学家们认为凯恩斯主义的反应虽然也许有很好的意图,但由于我们很快会讨论的原因,不会有很好的结果. 由于新古典主义经济学家认为经济会随着时间推移而自我矫正,凯恩斯主义稳定政策的唯一优势是加快进程,将失业人员失业的时间降到最低.有可能是这样的结果吗?

p89.original: Keynesian macroeconomic policy requires some optimism about the government's ability to recognize a situation of too little or too much aggregate demand, and to adjust aggregate demand accordingly with the right level of changes in taxes or spending, all enacted in a timely fashion. After all, neoclassical economists argue, it takes government statisticians months to produce even preliminary estimates of GDP so that politicians know whether a recession is occurring—and those preliminary estimates may be revised substantially later. Moreover, there is the question of timely action. The political process can take more months to enact a tax cut or a spending increase. Political or economic considerations may determine the amount of tax or spending changes. Then the economy will take still more months to put into effect changes in aggregate demand through spending and production. When economists and policy makers consider all of these time lags and political realities, active fiscal policy may fail to address the current problem, and could even make the future economy worse. The average U.S. post-World War II recession has lasted only about a year. By the time government policy activates, the recession will likely be over. As a consequence, the only result of government fine-tuning will be to stimulate the economy when it is already recovering (or to contract the economy when it is already falling). In other words, an active macroeconomic policy is likely to exacerbate the cycles rather than dampen them. Some neoclassical economists believe a large part of the business cycles we observe are due to flawed government policy. To learn about this issue further, read the following Clear It Up feature.
p89.zh: 凯恩斯宏观经济政策要求人们对于政府是否有能力承认总需求太少或太高的情况,并相应调整总需求,同时适当调整税收或支出水平,所有这些都是及时颁布的.毕竟,新古典主义经济学家认为,政府统计人员甚至要花几个月的时间才能提出GDP的初步估计,以便政治家们知道衰退是否正在发生,而这些初步估计可能在相当长的时间内修订。 此外,还有及时采取行动的问题。政治进程可能需要几个月的时间才能实行减税或增加开支。政治或经济考虑可以决定税额或支出变化。 然后,经济还需要几个月的时间才能通过支出和生产使总需求发生变化。 当经济学家和决策者考虑到所有这些时间滞后和政治现实时,积极的财政政策可能无法解决当前的问题,甚至可能使未来的经济更加恶化。 二战后美国平均经济衰退仅持续了约一年. 当政府政策启动时,衰退很可能已经结束。 因此,政府微调的唯一结果将是在经济已经复苏时刺激经济(或者在经济已经衰退时收缩经济)。换句话说,积极的宏观经济政策有可能加剧而不是抑制周期。 一些新古典主义经济学家认为,我们看到的商业周期有很大一部分是由于政府政策有缺陷所致. 为了进一步了解这一问题,请阅读以下的“澄清”特征。

p90.original: Why and how do economists measure inflation expectations?
p90.zh: 经济学家为什么以及如何衡量通货膨胀预期?

p91.original: People take expectations about inflation into consideration every time they make a major purchase, such as a house or a car. As inflation fluctuates, so too does the nominal interest rate on loans to buy these goods. The nominal interest rate is comprised of the real rate, plus an expected inflation factor. Expected inflation also tells economists about how the public views the economy's direction. Suppose the public expects inflation to increase. This could be the result of positive demand shock due to an expanding economy and increasing aggregate demand. It could also be the result of a negative supply shock, perhaps from rising energy prices, and decreasing aggregate supply. In either case, the public may expect the central bank to engage in contractionary monetary policy to reduce inflation, and this policy results in higher interest rates. If, however economists expect inflation to decrease, the public may anticipate a recession. In turn, the public may expect expansionary monetary policy, and lower interest rates, in the short run. By monitoring expected inflation, economists garner information about the effectiveness of macroeconomic policies. Additionally, monitoring expected inflation allows for projecting the direction of real interest rates that isolate for the effect of inflation. This information is necessary for making decisions about financing investments.
p91.zh: 人们每次进行大宗购买,如房屋或汽车,都会考虑通货膨胀的预期. 随着通货膨胀的波动,购买这些商品的贷款的名义利率也随之波动。名义利率由实际利率加上预期的通货膨胀因素组成。 预期通货膨胀也告诉经济学家,公众如何看待经济的方向。假设公众预计通货膨胀会上升.这可能是由于经济扩张和总需求增加造成需求积极冲击的结果。 这也可能是供应负冲击的结果,也许是能源价格上涨和总供应减少造成的。 无论在哪种情况下,公众都可能期望中央银行采取收缩性货币政策以减少通货膨胀,而这种政策导致利率上升. 如果经济学家预计通货膨胀会下降,公众可能会预测衰退。反过来,从短期来看,公众可能期待扩张性货币政策和降低利率。 通过监测预期的通货膨胀,经济学家获得关于宏观经济政策有效性的信息。 此外,对预期通货膨胀进行监测,可以预测实际利率的方向,这种利率将孤立于通货膨胀的影响。这些信息对于作出投资融资决定是必要的。

p92.original: Expectations about inflation may seem like a highly theoretical concept, but, in fact the Federal Reserve Bank measures, inflation expectations based upon early research conducted by Joseph Livingston, a financial journalist for the Philadelphia Inquirer. In 1946, he started a twice-a-year survey of economists about their expectations of inflation. After Livingston's death in 1969, the Federal Reserve Bank and other economic research agencies such as the Survey Research Center at the University of Michigan, the American Statistical Association, and the National Bureau of Economic Research continued the survey.
p92.zh: 对通货膨胀的期待可能看起来是一个高度理论性的概念,但事实上,联邦储备银行根据费城调查局金融记者约瑟夫·利文斯顿(Joseph Livingston)的早期研究对通货膨胀的期待进行了衡量.1946年,他开始每年两次调查经济学家对通货膨胀的预期.1969年利文斯顿逝世后,联邦储备银行和密歇根大学调查研究中心,美国统计协会,国家经济研究局等其他经济研究机构继续调查.

p93.original: Current Federal Reserve research compares these expectations to actual inflation that has occurred, and the results, so far, are mixed. Economists' forecasts, however, have become notably more accurate in the last few decades. Economists are actively researching how inflation expectations and other economic variables form and change.
p93.zh: 目前美联储的研究将这些预期与实际发生的通货膨胀相比较,迄今的结果好坏参半. 然而,经济学家的预测在过去几十年中明显变得更加准确。经济学家正在积极研究通货膨胀预期和其他经济变量是如何形成和变化的。

p94.original: Visit this website to read “The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland’s Economic Commentary: A New Approach to Gauging Inflation Expectations” by Joseph G. Haubrich for more information about how economists forecast  expected inflation.
p94.zh: 访问这个网站,读作《克利夫兰联邦储备银行的经济评论:衡量通货膨胀预期的新办法》,作者是Joseph G。Haubrich 了解经济学家如何预测通货膨胀。

p95.zh: 新古典主义的菲利普斯曲线权衡

p96.original: The Keynesian Perspective introduced the Phillips curve and explained how it is derived from the aggregate supply curve. The short run upward sloping aggregate supply curve implies a downward sloping Phillips curve; thus, there is a tradeoff between inflation and unemployment in the short run. By contrast, a neoclassical long-run aggregate supply curve will imply a vertical shape for the Phillips curve, indicating no long run tradeoff between inflation and unemployment.  (a) shows the vertical AS curve, with three different levels of aggregate demand, resulting in three different equilibria, at three different price levels. At every point along that vertical AS curve, potential GDP and the rate of unemployment remains the same. Assume that for this economy, the natural rate of unemployment is 5%. As a result, the long-run Phillips curve relationship, in  (b), is a vertical line, rising up from 5% unemployment, at any level of inflation. Read the following Work It Out feature for additional information on how to interpret inflation and unemployment rates.
p96.zh: 凯恩斯视角引入了菲利普斯曲线,并解释了它是如何从总供给曲线中推导出来的.短期上升的总供应曲线意味着菲利普斯曲线向下倾斜;因此,短期内通货膨胀与失业之间有权衡。相比之下,新古典主义的长期总供给曲线将意味着菲利普斯曲线的垂直形状,表明通货膨胀和失业之间没有长期的径流权衡.(a) 显示纵向AS曲线,总需求有三个不同的水平,结果在三个不同的价格水平上形成三个不同的等价。沿着纵向AS曲线的每一点,潜在的国内生产总值和失业率都保持不变。假设这一经济的自然失业率为5%。 因此,长期的菲利普斯曲线关系(b)中是一条垂直线,从5%的失业率上升至任何水平的通货膨胀.有关如何解释通货膨胀和失业率的更多信息,请阅读以下工作表。

p97.original: From a Long-Run AS Curve to a Long-Run Phillips Curve
p97.zh: 从长跑 AS 曲线到长跑 菲利普斯曲线

p98.zh: 跟踪通货膨胀和失业率

p99.original: Suppose that you have collected data for years on inflation and unemployment rates and recorded them in a table, such as . How do you interpret that information?
p99.zh: 假设您已经收集了多年来的通货膨胀和失业率数据,并将这些数据记录在一个表格中,例如: 你怎么解释这些信息?

p124.original: Step 1. Plot the data points in a graph with inflation rate on the vertical axis and unemployment rate on the horizontal axis. Your graph will appear similar to .
p124.zh: 步骤1。将数据点用图表标注在垂直轴上的通货膨胀率和水平轴上的失业率。 你的图表看起来和... 类似

p126.original: Step 2. What patterns do you see in the data? You should notice that there are years when unemployment falls but inflation rises, and other years where unemployment rises and inflation falls.
p126.zh: 步骤二. 你在数据里看到什么规律?请注意,有几年的失业率下降,但通货膨胀上升,有几年失业率上升,通货膨胀下降。

p127.original: Step 3. Can you determine the natural rate of unemployment from the data or from the graph? As you analyze the graph, it appears that the natural rate of unemployment lies at 4%. This is the rate that the economy appears to adjust back to after an apparent change in the economy. For example, in 1975 the economy appeared to have an increase in aggregate demand. The unemployment rate fell to 3% but inflation increased from 2% to 3%. By 1980, the economy had adjusted back to 4% unemployment and the inflation rate had returned to 2%. In 1985, the economy looks to have suffered a recession as unemployment rose to 6% and inflation fell to 1%. This would be consistent with a decrease in aggregate demand. By 1990, the economy recovered back to 4% unemployment, but at a lower inflation rate of 1%. In 1995 the economy again rebounded and unemployment fell to 2%, but inflation increased to 4%, which is consistent with a large increase in aggregate demand. The economy adjusted back to 4% unemployment but at a higher rate of inflation of 5%. Then in 2000, both unemployment and inflation increased to 5% and 4%, respectively.
p127.zh: 步骤3。 你能从数据或图表中确定自然失业率吗? 在您分析该图时,似乎自然失业率为4%。 这是经济在经济发生明显变化后似乎重新调整的速度。 例如,1975年,经济总需求似乎有所增加。失业率下降到3%,但通货膨胀率从2%上升到3%。 到1980年,经济调整为4%的失业率,通货膨胀率恢复到2%。1985年,由于失业率上升到6%,通货膨胀下降到1%,经济似乎遭受了衰退。 这与总需求的减少是一致的。 到1990年,经济恢复到4%的失业率,但通货膨胀率较低,为1%。1995年,经济再次反弹,失业率下降到2%,但通货膨胀上升到4%,这与总需求的大幅增长是一致的。经济调整为4%的失业率,但通货膨胀率较高,为5%。2000年,失业率和通货膨胀率分别上升到5%和4%。

p128.original: Step 4. Do you see the Phillips curve(s) in the data? If we trace the downward sloping trend of data points, we could see a short-run Phillips curve that exhibits the inverse tradeoff between higher unemployment and lower inflation rates. If we trace the vertical line of data points, we could see a long-run Phillips curve at the 4% natural rate of unemployment.
p128.zh: 步骤4。 你看到数据中的菲利普斯曲线了吗? 如果我们追踪数据点的下降趋势,我们可以看到菲利普斯的短线曲线,显示高失业率和低通货膨胀率之间的反向权衡。 如果我们追踪数据点的垂直线, 我们可以看到一个长期的菲利普斯曲线 以4%的自然失业率。

p129.original: The unemployment rate on the long-run Phillips curve will be the natural rate of unemployment. A small inflationary increase in the price level from AD0 to AD1 will have the same natural rate of unemployment as a larger inflationary increase in the price level from AD0 to AD2. The macroeconomic equilibrium along the vertical aggregate supply curve can occur at a variety of different price levels, and the natural rate of unemployment can be consistent with all different rates of inflation. The great economist Milton Friedman (1912–2006) summed up the neoclassical view of the long-term Phillips curve tradeoff in a 1967 speech: “[T]here is always a temporary trade-off between inflation and unemployment; there is no permanent trade-off.”
p129.zh: 长期菲利普斯曲线上的失业率将是自然失业率. 从AD0到AD1的价格水平略有通货膨胀上升,其自然失业率将与从AD0到AD2的价格水平较大通货膨胀上升相同。垂直总供给曲线沿线的宏观经济平衡可以在不同的价格水平上出现,自然失业率可以与所有不同的通货膨胀率一致.伟大的经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼(1912年—2006年)在1967年的一次演讲中总结了对菲利普斯长期曲线权衡的新古典主义观点 : “ 通货膨胀和失业总是暂时权衡;没有永久权衡。 ”

p130.original: In the Keynesian perspective, the primary focus is on getting the level of aggregate demand right in relationship to an upward-sloping aggregate supply curve. That is, the government should adjust AD so that the economy produces at its potential GDP, not so low that cyclical unemployment results and not so high that inflation results. In the neoclassical perspective, aggregate supply will determine output at potential GDP, the natural rate of unemployment determines unemployment, and shifts in aggregate demand are the primary determinant of changes in the price level.
p130.zh: 在凯恩斯主义观点中,主要重点是使总需求水平与向上倾斜的总供给曲线保持正轨.也就是说,政府应该调整反倾销,使经济产生其潜在的国内生产总值,而不是低到周期性失业的结果,而不是高到通货膨胀的结果。 在新古典主义观点中,总供应将决定潜在国内生产总值的产出,自然失业率决定失业,总需求的变化是物价水平变化的主要决定因素。

p131.original: Visit this website to read about the effects of economic intervention.
p131.zh: 访问该网站了解经济干预的影响.

p132.zh: 与失业或通货膨胀作斗争?

p133.original: As we explained in Unemployment, economists divide unemployment into two categories: cyclical unemployment and the natural rate of unemployment, which is the sum of frictional and structural unemployment. Cyclical unemployment results from fluctuations in the business cycle and is created when the economy is producing below potential GDP—giving potential employers less incentive to hire. When the economy is producing at potential GDP, cyclical unemployment will be zero. Because of labor market dynamics, in which people are always entering or exiting the labor force, the unemployment rate never falls to 0%, not even when the economy is producing at or even slightly above potential GDP. Probably the best we can hope for is for the number of job vacancies to equal the number of job seekers. We know that it takes time for job seekers and employers to find each other, and this time is the cause of frictional unemployment. Most economists do not consider frictional unemployment to be a “bad” thing. After all, there will always be workers who are unemployed while looking for a job that is a better match for their skills. There will always be employers that have an open position, while looking for a worker that is a better match for the job. Ideally, these matches happen quickly, but even when the economy is very strong there will be some natural unemployment and this is what the natural rate of unemployment measures.
p133.zh: 正如我们在《失业》中解释的那样,经济学家将失业分为两类:周期性失业和自然失业率,这是摩擦性和结构性失业的总和。循环失业是商业周期波动造成的,是在经济生产低于潜在国内总产值时产生的,给潜在雇主的雇用奖励较少。 当经济以潜在的国内生产总值生产时,周期性失业将是零。 由于劳动力市场的动态,人们总是在进入或退出劳动力队伍,因此失业率从未降至0%,即使经济在潜在国内生产总值方面正在生产,甚至略高于潜在国内生产总值。 也许我们所希望的最好办法是,职位空缺的数目与求职者的数目相等。 我们知道,求职者和雇主需要时间才能找到彼此,这次是摩擦性失业的原因。多数经济学家并不认为摩擦性失业是“坏的”。毕竟,总会有工人失业,同时寻找一个更适合其技能的工作。总会有雇主有公开的职位,同时寻找更适合该工作的工人。理想的情况是,这些匹配迅速发生,但即使经济非常强劲,也会有一些自然失业,这就是衡量失业的自然比率。

p134.original: The neoclassical view of unemployment tends to focus attention away from the cyclical unemployment problem—that is, unemployment caused by recession—while putting more attention on the unemployment rate issue that prevails even when the economy is operating at potential GDP. To put it another way, the neoclassical view of unemployment tends to focus on how the government can adjust public policy to reduce the natural rate of unemployment. Such policy changes might involve redesigning unemployment and welfare programs so that they support those in need, but also offer greater encouragement for job-hunting. It might involve redesigning business rules with an eye to whether they are unintentionally discouraging businesses from taking on new employees. It might involve building institutions to improve the flow of information about jobs and the mobility of workers, to help bring workers and employers together more quickly. For those workers who find that their skills are permanently no longer in demand (for example, the structurally unemployed), economists can design policy to provide opportunities for retraining so that these workers can reenter the labor force and seek employment.
p134.zh: 新古典主义的失业观点往往把注意力集中在周期性失业问题上,即衰退造成的失业,同时更加注意即使在经济以潜在的国内生产总值运作时仍然普遍存在的失业率问题。换句话说,新古典主义的失业观点倾向于侧重于政府如何调整公共政策,以降低自然失业率. 这种政策变化可能涉及重新设计失业和福利方案,以便支助有需要的人,但也为寻找工作提供了更大的鼓励。这可能涉及重新设计商业规则,着眼于这些规则是否无意中妨碍企业接纳新雇员。 它可能涉及建立机构,以改善有关工作和工人流动的信息流动,帮助工人和雇主更快地走到一起。 对于发现其技能已永远不再需要的工人(例如结构失业者),经济学家可以制定政策,提供再培训的机会,以便这些工人重新加入劳动力队伍并寻找工作。

p135.original: Neoclassical economists will not tend to see aggregate demand as a useful tool for reducing unemployment; after all, with a vertical aggregate supply curve determining economic output, then aggregate demand has no long-run effect on unemployment. Instead, neoclassical economists believe that aggregate demand should be allowed to expand only to match the gradual shifts of aggregate supply to the right—keeping the price level much the same and inflationary pressures low.
p135.zh: 新古典主义经济学家不会倾向于将总需求视为减少失业的有用工具;毕竟,总需求通过垂直总供给曲线决定经济产出,那么总需求就不会对失业产生长期影响. 相反,新古典主义经济学家认为,应当允许总需求扩大,只为了配合总供应逐渐向正确方向转移,使价格水平保持相当水平,通货膨胀压力降低。

p136.original: If aggregate demand rises rapidly in the neoclassical model, in the long run it leads only to inflationary pressures.  shows a vertical LRAS curve and three different levels of aggregate demand, rising from AD0 to AD1 to AD2. As the macroeconomic equilibrium rises from E0 to E1 to E2, the price level rises, but real GDP does not budge; nor does the rate of unemployment, which adjusts to its natural rate. Conversely, reducing inflation has no long-term costs, either. Think about  in reverse, as the aggregate demand curve shifts from AD2 to AD1 to AD0, and the equilibrium moves from E2 to E1 to E0. During this process, the price level falls, but, in the long run, neither real GDP nor the natural unemployment rate changes.
p136.zh: 如果总需求在新古典主义模式中迅速上升,那么从长远来看,它只会导致通胀压力. LISS曲线显示垂直,总需求水平也各不相同,从AD0升至AD1升至AD2. 随着宏观经济平衡从E0升至E1升至E2,物价水平不断上升,但实际GDP并未减弱;失业率也随之下降,这与自然利率相适应.反之,降低通货膨胀也不产生长期成本。思考反向,随着总需求曲线从AD2向AD1向AD0转变,平衡从E2向E1向E0移动. 在这一过程中,价格水平下降,但从长远来看,实际国内生产总值和自然失业率都没有变化。

p137.original: How Aggregate Demand Determines the Price Level in the Long Run
p137.zh: 需求总量如何确定长期运行中的价格水平

p138.original: Visit this website to read about how inflation and unemployment are related.
p138.zh: 访问该网站,了解通货膨胀与失业之间的关系。

p139.original: Fighting Recession or Encouraging Long-Term Growth?
p139.zh: 与衰退作斗争还是鼓励长期增长?

p140.original: Neoclassical economists believe that the economy will rebound out of a recession or eventually contract during an expansion because prices and wage rates are flexible and will adjust either upward or downward to restore the economy to its potential GDP. Thus, the key policy question for neoclassicals is how to promote growth of potential GDP. We know that economic growth ultimately depends on the growth rate of long-term productivity. Productivity measures how effective inputs are at producing outputs. We know that U.S. productivity has grown on average about 2% per year. That means that the same amount of inputs produce 2% more output than the year before. We also know that productivity growth varies a great deal in the short term due to cyclical factors. It also varies somewhat in the long term. From 1953–1972, U.S. labor productivity (as measured by output per hour in the business sector) grew at 3.2% per year. From 1973–1992, productivity growth declined significantly to 1.8% per year. Then, from 1993–2010, productivity growth increased to around 2% per year. In recent years, it has grown less than 2% per year, although it did pick up in 2019 and 2020 to over 2% again. The neoclassical economists believe the underpinnings of long-run productivity growth to be an economy’s investments in human capital, physical capital, and technology, operating together in a market-oriented environment that rewards innovation. Government policy should focus on promoting these factors.
p140.zh: 新古典主义经济学家认为,由于价格和工资率是灵活的,经济会向上或向下调整,以恢复其潜在的国内生产总值,因此经济将摆脱衰退或最终在扩张期间收缩. 因此,新古典主义的关键政策问题是如何促进潜在国内生产总值的增长。 我们知道,经济增长最终取决于长期生产力的增长率。生产力衡量产出的有效投入。 我们知道美国的生产率平均每年增长约2%. 这意味着,同样数量的投入产出比前一年多出2%。 我们还知道,由于周期性因素,生产率增长在短期内有很大差异。 从长远来看,情况也有些不同。 从1953年-1972年,美国劳动生产率(以商业部门每小时产出衡量)每年增长3.2%。 从1973年-1992年,生产力增长显著下降,每年降至1.8%. 此后,从1993-2010年,生产力增长每年增至约2%。 近年来,年增长率不到2%,尽管在2019年和2020年,它确实再次回升到2%以上. 新古典主义经济学家认为,长期生产力增长的基础是一个经济体对人力资本、有形资本和技术的投资,在一个有利于创新的面向市场的环境中共同运作。 政府政策应侧重于促进这些因素。

p141.original: Summary of Neoclassical Macroeconomic Policy Recommendations
p141.zh: 新古典宏观经济政策建议摘要

p142.original: Let’s summarize what neoclassical economists recommend for macroeconomic policy. Neoclassical economists do not believe in “fine-tuning” the economy. They believe that a stable economic environment with a low rate of inflation fosters economic growth. Similarly, tax rates should be low and unchanging. In this environment, private economic agents can make the best possible investment decisions, which will lead to optimal investment in physical and human capital as well as research and development to promote improvements in technology.
p142.zh: 让我们总结一下新古典主义经济学家对宏观经济政策的建议。 新古典主义经济学家不相信“精细调整”经济。 他们认为,一个稳定的经济环境,低通货膨胀率,可以促进经济增长。 同样,税率应低而不变。 在这种环境中,私营经济行为者可以作出尽可能最好的投资决定,从而对实物和人力资本进行最佳投资,并进行研究和开发,促进技术的改进。

p143.zh: 新古典经济学对凯恩斯经济学的总结

p144.original: summarizes the key differences between the two schools of thought.
p144.zh: 总结了两个思想流派之间的主要差异。

p152.original: Prices and wages: sticky or flexible?

p170.zh: 总需求是否是结束衰退的有用工具?

p171.zh: 充其量只是短期的暂时性 但可能只是增加通货膨胀

p174.original: Neoclassical economists tend to put relatively more emphasis on long-term growth than on fighting recession, because they believe that recessions will fade in a few years and long-term growth will ultimately determine the standard of living. They tend to focus more on reducing the natural rate of unemployment caused by economic institutions and government policies than the cyclical unemployment caused by recession.
p174.zh: 新古典主义经济学家倾向于相对更多地强调长期增长而不是对抗衰退,因为他们认为衰退将在几年内消退,长期增长最终将决定生活水平. 它们往往更注重降低经济体制和政府政策造成的自然失业率,而不是衰退造成的周期性失业。

p175.original: Neoclassical economists also see no social benefit to inflation. With an upward-sloping Keynesian AS curve, inflation can arise because an economy is approaching full employment. With a vertical long-run neoclassical AS curve, inflation does not accompany any rise in output. If aggregate supply is vertical, then aggregate demand does not affect the quantity of output. Instead, aggregate demand can only cause inflationary changes in the price level. A vertical aggregate supply curve, where the quantity of output is consistent with many different price levels, also implies a vertical Phillips curve.
p175.zh: 新古典主义经济学家也认为通货膨胀没有社会福利. 随着凯恩斯AS曲线的上升,通货膨胀可能会出现,因为经济正接近充分就业。有了垂直的长期新古典主义AS曲线,通货膨胀不会伴随产出的任何上升. 如果总供给是垂直的,那么总需求不影响产出的数量. 相反,总需求只能导致价格水平的通货膨胀变化。垂直总供给曲线,输出量与许多不同的价格水平一致,也意味着垂直菲利普斯曲线.

p177.original: Legislation proposes that the government should use macroeconomic policy to achieve an unemployment rate of zero percent, by increasing aggregate demand for as much and as long as necessary to accomplish this goal. From a neoclassical perspective, how will this policy affect output and the price level in the short run and in the long run? Sketch an aggregate demand/aggregate supply diagram to illustrate your answer. Hint: revisit .
p177.zh: 立法建议政府利用宏观经济政策,通过增加总需求,尽可能满足实现这一目标的需要,实现失业率为零的目标。 从新古典主义的角度来看,从短期和长期来看,这项政策将如何影响产出和价格水平?绘制一个总需求/总需求供应图,以说明您的答案。提示:重温。

p178.original: An unemployment rate of zero percent is presumably well below the rate that is consistent with potential GDP and with the natural rate of unemployment. As a result, this policy would be attempting to push AD out to the right.
p178.zh: 失业率为零,估计远低于与潜在国内生产总值和自然失业率相一致的增长率。 因此,这项政策将试图将反倾销推向右。

p179.original: In the short run, it is possible to have unemployment slightly below the natural rate for a time, at a price of higher inflation, as shown by the movement from E0 to E1 along the short-run AS curve. However, over time the extremely low unemployment rates will tend to cause wages to be bid up, and shift the short-run AS curve back to the left. The result would be a higher price level, but an economy still at potential GDP and the natural rate of unemployment, as determined by the long-run AS curve. If the government continues this policy, it will continually be pushing the price level higher and higher, but it will not be able to achieve its goal of zero percent unemployment, because that goal is inconsistent with market forces.
p179.zh: 短期内,失业率有可能一度略低于自然比率,以较高的通货膨胀率为代价,这表现在从E0到E1沿短期AS曲线的移动. 然而,随着时间的推移,极低的失业率往往会导致工资上涨,并将短期AS曲线转向左。其结果将是物价水平提高,但经济仍然处于潜在的国内生产总值和自然失业率,这由长期AS曲线决定。 如果政府继续推行这一政策,它将继续不断推动物价水平的提高,但将无法实现失业率为零的目标,因为这一目标与市场力量不符。

p180.original: Would it make sense to argue that rational expectations economics is an extreme version of neoclassical economics? Explain.
p180.zh: 认为理性期望经济学是新古典主义经济学的极端版本,这有道理吗?解释一下

p181.original: The statement is accurate. Rational expectations can be thought of as a version of neoclassical economics because it argues that potential GDP and the rate of unemployment are shaped by market forces as wages and prices adjust. However, it is an “extreme” version because it argues that this adjustment takes place very quickly. Other theories, like adaptive expectations, suggest that adjustment to the neoclassical outcome takes a few years.
p181.zh: 说法精准.合理预期可以被认为是新古典主义经济学的一种版本,因为它认为潜在的GDP和失业率是随着工资和价格的调整而由市场力量决定的. 然而,这是一个“极端”的版本,因为它认为这一调整是很快进行的。 其他理论,如适应性预期,则认为适应新古典主义结果需要几年时间.

p184.original: Do neoclassical economists tend to focus more on cyclical unemployment or on inflation? Explain briefly.

p194.zh: 平衡凯恩斯主义和新古典主义模式

p195.original: We can compare finding the balance between Keynesian and Neoclassical models to the challenge of riding two horses simultaneously. When a circus performer stands on two horses, with a foot on each one, much of the excitement for the viewer lies in contemplating the gap between the two. As modern macroeconomists ride into the future on two horses—with one foot on the short-term Keynesian perspective and one foot on the long-term neoclassical perspective—the balancing act may look uncomfortable, but there does not seem to be any way to avoid it. Each approach, Keynesian and neoclassical, has its strengths and weaknesses.
p195.zh: 我们可以比较一下凯恩斯主义和新古典主义模型之间的平衡 来应对同时骑两匹马的挑战。 当一个马戏团的表演者站在两匹马上,每匹马都有一个脚时,观众的兴奋感大多在于考虑两者之间的差距. 当现代宏观经济学家骑着两匹马——一只脚站在凯恩斯主义的短期视角上,一只脚站在长期的新古典主义视角上——进入未来时,平衡行为可能显得不舒服,但似乎没有任何方法可以避免它.每一种方法,凯恩斯主义和新古典主义,都有其优缺点.

p196.original: The short-term Keynesian model, built on the importance of aggregate demand as a cause of business cycles and a degree of wage and price rigidity, does a sound job of explaining many recessions and why cyclical unemployment rises and falls. By focusing on the short-run aggregate demand adjustments, Keynesian economics risks overlooking the long-term causes of economic growth or the natural rate of unemployment that exist even when the economy is producing at potential GDP.
p196.zh: 短期凯恩斯主义模式建立在总需求作为商业周期原因以及工资和价格一定程度的僵化程度的重要性之上,它很好地解释了许多衰退的原因和周期性失业率的上升和下降。 凯恩斯经济学通过注重短期总需求调整,有可能忽略经济增长的长期原因或即使经济在潜在国内生产总值中生产时也存在的自然失业率。

p197.original: The neoclassical model, with its emphasis on aggregate supply, focuses on the underlying determinants of output and employment in markets, and thus tends to put more emphasis on economic growth and how labor markets work. However, the neoclassical view is not especially helpful in explaining why unemployment moves up and down over short time horizons of a few years. Nor is the neoclassical model especially helpful when the economy is mired in an especially deep and long-lasting recession, like the 1930s Great Depression. Keynesian economics tends to view inflation as a price that might sometimes be paid for lower unemployment; neoclassical economics tends to view inflation as a cost that offers no offsetting gains in terms of lower unemployment.
p197.zh: 新古典主义模式以总供应为重点,侧重于产出和市场就业的基本决定因素,因此倾向于更加重视经济增长以及劳动力市场的运作。 然而,新古典主义观点对解释失业在短短几年内上下移动的原因没有特别帮助。 新古典主义模式在经济陷入特别深刻和持久的衰退,如1930年代的大萧条时,也没有特别的帮助。 凯恩斯主义经济学倾向于将通货膨胀视为有时可能为降低失业率而支付的价格;新古典主义经济学倾向于将通货膨胀视为一种成本,而从降低失业率的角度来说,这种成本不会产生抵消性收益.

p198.original: Macroeconomics cannot, however, be summed up as an argument between one group of economists who are pure Keynesians and another group who are pure neoclassicists. Instead, many mainstream economists believe both the Keynesian and neoclassical perspectives. Robert Solow, the Nobel laureate in economics in 1987, described the dual approach in this way:
p198.zh: 然而,宏观经济学不能概括为纯粹是凯恩斯主义者的一组经济学家和纯粹是新古典主义者的一组经济学家之间的争论. 相反,许多主流经济学家既相信凯恩斯主义的观点,也相信新古典主义的观点.1987年诺贝尔经济学奖得主罗伯特·索洛(Robert Solow)以这种方式描述了这一双重方法:

p199.original: At short time scales, I think, something sort of ‘Keynesian’ is a good approximation, and surely better than anything straight ‘neoclassical.’ At very long time scales, the interesting questions are best studied in a neoclassical framework, and attention to the Keynesian side of things would be a minor distraction. At the five-to-ten-year time scale, we have to piece things together as best we can, and look for a hybrid model that will do the job.
p199.zh: 我认为,在短时间尺度上,某种“凯恩斯主义”是一个很好的近似,而且肯定比任何直线“古典主义”更好。 在很长的时间尺度上,有趣的问题最好在新古典主义框架内研究,而关注凯恩斯主义方面的事情将是一个小分心。 在5到10年的时间尺度上,我们必须尽可能地把事情拼凑在一起,并寻找一个能够完成任务的混合模式.

p200.original: Many modern macroeconomists spend considerable time and energy trying to construct models that blend the most attractive aspects of the Keynesian and neoclassical approaches. It is possible to construct a somewhat complex mathematical model where aggregate demand and sticky wages and prices matter in the short run, but wages, prices, and aggregate supply adjust in the long run. However, creating an overall model that encompasses both short-term Keynesian and long-term neoclassical models is not easy.
p200.zh: 许多现代宏观经济学家花费了大量的时间和精力,试图构建将凯恩斯主义和新古典主义方法最有吸引力的方面结合起来的模型. 可以构建一个比较复杂的数学模型,从短期来看,总需求和粘性工资和价格都很重要,但从长期来看,工资、价格和总供应都有所调整。 然而,创造一个既包括短期凯恩斯主义模式也包括长期新古典主义模式的整体模式并不容易.

p201.original: Navigating Uncharted Waters—The Great Recession and Pandemic-Induced Recession of 2020
p201.zh: 导航未定水域——2020年大衰退与大流行诱导衰退.

p202.original: Were the policies that the government implemented to stabilize the economy and financial markets during the Great Recession of 2007–2009, and the pandemic-induced recession of 2020 effective? Many economists from both the Keynesian and neoclassical schools have found that they were, although to varying degrees. Regarding the Great Recession, Alan Blinder of Princeton University and Mark Zandi for Moody’s Analytics found that, without fiscal policy, GDP decline would have been significantly more than its 3.3% in 2008 followed by its 0.1% decline in 2009. They also estimated that there would have been 8.5 million more job losses had the government not intervened in the market with the TARP to support the financial industry and key automakers General Motors and Chrysler. Federal Reserve Bank economists Carlos Carvalho, Stefano Eusip, and Christian Grisse found in their study, Policy Initiatives in the Global Recession: What Did Forecasters Expect? that once the government implemented policies, forecasters adapted their expectations to these policies. They were more likely to anticipate increases in investment due to lower interest rates brought on by monetary policy and increased economic growth resulting from fiscal policy.
p202.zh: 政府为稳定2007-2009年大衰退期间的经济和金融市场而实施的政策以及2020年大流行病引发的衰退是否有效? 许多来自凯恩斯主义和新古典主义学派的经济学家都发现,尽管程度不同. 关于大衰退,普林斯顿大学的艾伦·布莱德(Alan Blinder)和马克·赞迪(Mark Zandi)为穆迪的分析师发现,如果没有财政政策,2008年的GDP下降率会大大超过其3.3%,随后2009年的GDP下降率为0.1%. 他们还估计,如果政府不与TARP一起干预市场,支持金融业和主要的汽车制造商通用汽车公司和克莱斯勒公司,就会有更多的850万人失业。美联储经济学家Carlos Carvalho、Stefano Eusip和Christian Grisse在其研究《全球衰退中的政策倡议:预测者们期望什么? 》 中发现,一旦政府执行了政策,预测者们就根据这些政策调整了他们的预期。 由于货币政策带来的利率较低,财政政策导致经济增长增加,它们更可能预见到投资的增加。

p203.original: The neoclassical perspective can also shed light on the country’s experience with policy during the pandemic-induced recession of 2020. It was mentioned earlier that one criticism made by proponents of the neoclassical perspective is that government policy is often too slow to react to a recession. However after the pandemic hit, the federal government quickly responded with aid to state and local governments, increased unemployment insurance, aid to businesses forced to shut down, and stimulus checks to boost spending. There is no doubt that the economic fallout from the pandemic would have been much worse without these policies. Some economists even argue that the government helped too much and that the high inflation the U.S. economy experienced starting mid-2021 is due to the real output growing faster than potential, but it is too early (as of early 2022) to tell if that argument is correct.
p203.zh: 新古典主义观点也可以揭示该国在2020年大流行引发的衰退期间的政策经验. 有人早些时候提到,新古典主义观点的支持者提出的一个批评是,政府政策往往太慢,无法对经济衰退作出反应。 然而,在疫情发生后,联邦政府迅速对州政府和地方政府做出回应,增加了失业保险,向被迫停业的企业提供了援助,并采取了刺激性检查措施,以刺激支出。 毫无疑问,没有这些政策,这种流行病的经济后果会更糟。 一些经济学家甚至认为,政府帮助过大,美国经济从2021年中开始经历的高通胀率是由于实际产出增长比潜力快,但现在还为时过早(截至2022年初)来判断这一论点是否正确.

p204.original: By focusing on potential GDP instead of short-run demand, the neoclassical perspective also makes an important point about how the size of the economy determines its ability to grow. Since the pandemic hit, millions of workers have stayed out of the labor market due to early retirement, health and safety concerns, the availability of childcare, and school closures. As mentioned in Unemployment, these changes have caused labor force participation to remain lower than its historical average. The pandemic has also made it harder for future workers to acquire skills they need to be productive in the labor market. The longer these dynamics are at play, the more harm it will do to potential GDP.
p204.zh: 新古典主义观点通过注重潜在的GDP而不是短期需求,也提出了经济规模如何决定其增长能力的重要观点. 自从这一大流行病发生以来,数百万工人由于提前退休、健康和安全关切、提供托儿服务以及学校关闭等原因一直留在劳动力市场之外。 如《失业》所述,这些变化导致劳动力参与率低于其历史平均水平。 这一大流行病还使未来的工人更难获得在劳动力市场上生产所需的技能。 这些动态作用的时间越长,对潜在国内生产总值的伤害就越大。

p206.original: The Keynesian perspective considers changes to aggregate demand to be the cause of business cycle fluctuations. Keynesians are likely to advocate that policy makers actively attempt to reverse recessionary and inflationary periods because they are not convinced that the self-correcting economy can easily return to full employment.
p206.zh: 凯恩斯主义观点认为,对总需求的变化是导致商业周期波动的原因. 凯恩斯主义者可能主张决策者积极试图扭转衰退期和通货膨胀期,因为他们不相信自我修正的经济可以轻松地恢复充分就业.

p207.original: The neoclassical perspective places more emphasis on aggregate supply. Neoclassical economists believe that  long term productivity growth determines the potential GDP level and that the economy typically will return to full employment after a change in aggregate demand. Skeptical of the effectiveness and timeliness of Keynesian policy, neoclassical economists are more likely to advocate a hands-off, or fairly limited, role for active stabilization policy.
p207.zh: 新古典主义观点更加强调总供给. 新古典主义经济学家认为,长期生产力增长决定了潜在的GDP水平,经济一般会在总需求变化后恢复充分就业. 新古典主义经济学家对凯恩斯主义政策的有效性和及时性持怀疑态度,他们更可能主张让积极稳定政策发挥作用,或者说相当有限。

p208.original: While Keynesians would tend to advocate an acceptable tradeoff between inflation and unemployment when counteracting a recession, neoclassical economists argue that no such tradeoff exists. Any short-term gains in lower unemployment will eventually vanish and the result of active policy will only be inflation.
p208.zh: 虽然凯恩斯主义者倾向于主张在应对衰退时在通货膨胀和失业之间达成可以接受的权衡,但新古典主义经济学家认为不存在这种权衡。降低失业率的任何短期收益最终都将消失,而积极政策的结果只是通货膨胀。

p210.original: Summarize the Keynesian and Neoclassical models.
p210.zh: 总结凯恩斯主义和新古典主义的模型.

p211.original: The short-term Keynesian model is built on the importance of aggregate demand as a cause of business cycles and a degree of wage and price rigidity, and thus does a sound job of explaining many recessions and why cyclical unemployment rises and falls. The neoclassical model emphasizes aggregate supply by focusing on the underlying determinants of output and employment in markets, and thus tends to put more emphasis on economic growth and how labor markets work.
p211.zh: 短期凯恩斯主义模式建立在总需求作为商业周期原因和一定程度的工资和价格僵硬性的重要性之上,因此做了一个解释许多衰退和周期性失业上升和下降原因的正确工作. 新古典主义模式强调总供应,注重产出和市场就业的基本决定因素,因此倾向于更加重视经济增长和劳动力市场的运作。

p213.original: When the economy is experiencing a recession, why would a neoclassical economist be unlikely to argue for aggressive policy to stimulate aggregate demand and return the economy to full employment? Explain your answer.
p213.zh: 当经济正经历衰退时,为什么一位新古典主义经济学家不太可能为刺激总需求和使经济恢复充分就业的激进政策而争论呢?解释你的答案。

p214.original: If the economy is suffering through a rampant inflationary period, would a Keynesian economist advocate for stabilization policy that involves higher taxes and higher interest rates? Explain your answer.
p214.zh: 如果经济正经历着严重的通货膨胀时期,那么凯恩斯经济学家会主张实行涉及高税收和高利率的稳定政策吗?解释你的答案。

p216.original: Is it a logical contradiction to be a neoclassical Keynesian? Explain.
p216.zh: 成为新古典主义的凯恩斯主义者是逻辑上的矛盾吗?解释一下

c1.original: Actual GDP falls below potential GDP during and after recessions, like the recessions of 1980 and 1981–82, 1990–91, 2001, and 2008–2009 and continues below potential GDP until 2019, when it goes slightly above potential. In other cases, actual GDP can be above potential GDP for a time, as in the late 1990s.
c1.zh: 实际国内生产总值在衰退期间和之后都低于潜在国内生产总值,如1980年和1981-82年、1990-91年、2001年和2008-2009年的衰退,一直低于潜在国内生产总值,直到2019年才略高于潜力。 在其他情况下,实际国内生产总值可以一度高于潜在国内生产总值,如1990年代后期。

c2.original: In the neoclassical model, we draw the aggregate supply curve as a vertical line at the level of potential GDP. If AS is vertical, then it determines the level of real output, no matter where we draw the aggregate demand curve. Over time, the LRAS curve shifts to the right as productivity increases and potential GDP expands.
c2.zh: 在新古典主义模式中,我们绘制总供给曲线,作为潜在GDP水平的垂直线. 如果AS是垂直的,那么它决定了实际输出的水平,无论我们从哪里画出总需求曲线. 随着时间推移,随着生产力的提高和潜在国内生产总值的扩大,LISS曲线向右转变。

c3.original: The original equilibrium (E0), at an output level of 500 and a price level of 120, happens at the intersection of the aggregate demand curve (AD0) and the short-run aggregate supply curve (SRAS0). The output at E0 is equal to potential GDP. Aggregate demand shifts right from AD0 to AD1. The new equilibrium is E1, with a higher output level of 550 and an increase in the price level to 125. With unemployment rates unsustainably low, eager employers bid up wages, which shifts short-run aggregate supply to the left, from SRAS0 to SRAS1. The new equilibrium (E2) is at the same original level of output, 500, but at a higher price level of 130. Thus, the long-run aggregate supply curve (LRASn), which is vertical at the level of potential GDP, determines the level of real GDP in this economy in the long run.
c3.zh: 原始平衡(E0),输出水平为500,价格水平为120,发生在总需求曲线(AD0)和短期总供给曲线(SRAS0)的交汇处.E0的产出等于潜在的GDP.需求总量从AD0向AD1的正转。 新平衡为E1型,产出水平较高,为550级,价格水平提高到125级. 由于失业率低得难以持续,热心的雇主竞相提高工资,从而将短期总供应从SRAS0转向SRAS1。新的平衡(E2)在原始输出水平上相同,为500,但价格较高,为130. 因此,长期总供应曲线(LIRSn)在潜在国内总产值水平上是垂直的,它决定了这一经济体的长期实际国内总产值水平。

c4.original: The original equilibrium (E0), at an output level of 500 and a price level of 120, happens at the intersection of the aggregate demand curve (AD0) and the short-run aggregate supply curve (SRAS0). The output at E0 is equal to potential GDP. Aggregate demand shifts left, from AD0 to AD1. The new equilibrium is at E1, with a lower output level of 450 and downward pressure on the price level of 115. With high unemployment rates, wages are held down. Lower wages are an economy-wide decrease in the price of a key input, which shifts short-run aggregate supply to the right, from SRAS0 to SRAS1. The new equilibrium (E2) is at the same original level of output, 500, but at a lower price level of 110.
c4.zh: 原始平衡(E0),输出水平为500,价格水平为120,发生在总需求曲线(AD0)和短期总供给曲线(SRAS0)的交汇处.E0的产出等于潜在的GDP. 从AD0到AD1的总需求转移。 新平衡为E1级,产出水平较低,450级,价格水平下压115级. 由于失业率高,工资被压低。低工资是整个经济的关键投入价格的下降,将短期总供应从SRAS0转向SRAS1。新的平衡(E2)在原始输出水平上相同,为500,但价格较低,为110.

c5.original: (a) With a vertical LRAS curve, shifts in aggregate demand do not alter the level of output but do lead to changes in the price level. Because output is unchanged between the equilibria E0, E1, and E2, all unemployment in this economy will be due to the natural rate of unemployment. (b) If the natural rate of unemployment is 5%, then the Phillips curve will be vertical. That is, regardless of changes in the price level, the unemployment rate remains at 5%.
c5.zh: (a) 采用垂直的LISS曲线,总需求的变化不会改变产出水平,但确实会导致价格水平的变化。 由于在E0、E1和E2之间产出没有变化,因此,这一经济中的所有失业都将是自然失业率造成的。(b) 如果自然失业率为5%,那么菲利普斯曲线将是垂直的。也就是说,无论价格水平如何变化,失业率仍然保持在5%。

c6.original: As aggregate demand shifts to the right, from AD0 to AD1 to AD2, real GDP in this economy and the level of unemployment do not change. However, there is inflationary pressure for a higher price level as the equilibrium changes from E0 to E1 to E2.
c6.zh: 随着总需求向右转移,从AD0向AD1向AD2转变,这一经济体的实际国内生产总值和失业率没有变化。 然而,随着平衡从E0到E1到E2的改变,通胀压力很大,要求提高价格水平.
